campus.notice: Campus location names and high-level functions are based on public university references. The only routable graph is an illustrative teaching model; its layout, corridors, distances, exits, capacities, and routes are not verified DIT University information.

locations.name: Vedanta
locations.verified_description: The 2023–24 brochure lists the School of Computing, Admissions Office, Veda Library, and Indoor Auditorium at Vedanta.

locations.name: Chanakya
locations.verified_description: The brochure identifies Chanakya as the Administrative Block and lists engineering departments there.

locations.name: Charak
locations.verified_description: The brochure identifies Charak with the Faculty of Pharmacy.

locations.name: Vastu
locations.verified_description: The brochure identifies Vastu with the Faculty of Architecture & Design; the virtual tour uses the spelling Vaastu.

locations.name: Vishveshwarya
locations.verified_description: The brochure map identifies Vishveshwarya with Civil Engineering, Petroleum & Energy Studies, and Management Studies.

models.name: Vedanta — illustrative evacuation model
models.description: A five-floor illustrative graph with four rooms, two computer labs and a connected staircase on each floor. The graph is designed for teaching route planning and evacuation simulation; it is not a verified floor plan.
